import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,re
lane=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/latin.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'sources/latin.txt'],input=r.stdout,capture_output=True,text=True);assert z.returncode==0
s=r.stdout;print(s[:13500]);print('REMOVAL LOCATIONS',[(m.start(),s[max(0,m.start()-100):m.start()+160]) for m in re.finditer('removal',s)])
